album.title: you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love [Explicit]

wiki.summary: ‘less’ is the eleventh track off Olivia Rodrigo’s third studio album, ‘you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love’. The song details the last attempts at saving the relationship and its sorrowful end. Rodrigo wishes the muse loved her less so that the relationship would continue or the fallout was less painful than ended up being. The title was officially announced on May 26th, 2026 and eventually released on June 12th, 2026, along with the rest of the album. Read more on Last.fm.
